subject: Auroraplex SIG: forensics playbook, log samples, and scheduling
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@auroraplex.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: sec-portal@auroraplex.com, jakub@auroraplex.com
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG call request + forensics/log sampling questions

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for agreeing to help Auroraplex run through the SIG and CAIQ. We wanted to kick off with a technical deep-dive oriented around forensic artefacts and log sampling so our internal auditors can validate retention and collection controls. Can we schedule a 45-min call next week?

Specific asks to cover on the call:
- What log types Redwood can provide as samples (e.g., application logs, request traces, Cloud provider audit logs, KV cache eviction traces)
- Format and retention windows for logs (preferred sampling windows for CAIQ evidence)
- Masking/Pseudonymization approach for customer PII in samples
- Playbook for incident investigations (timeline, who provides PoCs, timeline for data pulls)

We can share our internal runbook ahead of time. Available windows (PDT): Tue 8/31 10:00-12:00, Wed 9/1 13:00-16:00, Thu 9/2 morning.

Thanks,
Maria Gonzalez
Security Operations
Auroraplex
[maria.gonzalez@auroraplex.com]
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@auroraplex.com>
Cc: david.kim@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG call request + forensics/log sampling questions

Hi Maria — appreciate the clear asks. We can definitely cover all of that. Proposed plan: 1) 45-min tech deep-dive (what logs, delivery formats, masking), 2) brief demo of a sanitized log sample export, 3) alignment on runbook steps and ownership.

I can do Tue 8/31 at 10:30 PDT. David (infra/compliance) will join to talk about CloudTrail/host-level exports and retention. Kimberly (security PM) will cover evidence packaging and CAIQ mapping.

Quick clarifications so we prepare the right artifacts:
- Do you want a full syslog sample + CloudTrail slice, or a curated application-request trace + KV cache history (or both)?
- For PII, do you want us to redact deterministically (replace with consistent tokens) or fully anonymize? Auditors sometimes want consistent tokens to prove chain-of-custody.

I’ll attach the sample inventory we typically provide. If that looks good I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0184
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@auroraplex.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: sec-portal@auroraplex.com, jakub@auroraplex.com
Date: 2026-08-29T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG call request + forensics/log sampling questions

Thanks Tessa — Tue 8/31 10:30 PDT works for us.

Responses to clarifications:
- Ideally both: a small curated application-request trace (30–50 requests) plus a slice of CloudTrail for the same window. That helps our auditors cross-check events.
- Deterministic tokenization is preferred (consistent token per original value) so we can follow a subject across messages.

Also: can Redwood produce a short note on your investigation timelines (TTR for triage, time to provide full exports after a request, typical SLAs)? Our procurement team will want to capture that in the SOW.

We’ll upload our runbook draft to the Drive link and add the list of compliance reviewers.

—Maria
